qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.boundedRule: Tier one admits only the exact eight-byte, two-instruction fixture block with MOVSXD ECX to RAX followed by locked qword BTS through RSI. The same bytes at an adjacent RIP decline.
admission.atomicity: The existing translated-memory compare-exchange callback implements the locked update. A CAS mismatch supplies the next expected value without a non-atomic read, and the successful replaced value determines CF.
admission.transactionality: The preceding MOVSXD and materialized flag image remain in the temporary execution context until the atomic callback succeeds; callback failure discards the whole block and retries at its entry RIP.

verification.focusedGate: The exact measured atomic-memory-BTS test passes.
verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,457 tests in 171 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Signed indices 0, 63, 64, -1, and -65 and both old-bit states match the interpreter exactly in architectural state and memory, including ECX-to-RAX sign extension.
verification.atomicCoverage: Eight concurrent tier-one executions set the same clear bit: exactly one observes old CF=0, seven observe CF=1, and the final qword has exactly that bit set.
verification.negativeCoverage: The same bytes at an adjacent RIP decline, and an inaccessible target rolls state and memory back to the block-entry checkpoint.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. Absence of the measured site directly establishes bounded admission; aggregate and elapsed movements are reported for completeness and are not a performance claim.

interpretation: The measured locked memory-BTS block is absent from the retained negative-cache sample and the authenticated workload completes. A05.2 remains open because 120,197 of 221,529 full-run tier-one attempts still decline.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The negative-cache sampler is capped and proves absence only from the retained visible list.
This evidence establishes no statistical performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
